observations.body: Jesus addresses Simon son of Jonah three times; Peter answers three times and receives three feeding commands.
observations.label: Three exchanges

observations.body: The third question grieves Peter, whose answer appeals to Jesus’s knowledge.
observations.label: Grief and knowledge

observations.body: A saying about age and death is followed by the narrator’s explanation and the command “Follow me.”
observations.label: Future and following

payload.posture: Notice exact repetition and variation before relating the scene to Peter’s earlier words or later work.
payload.tension: The repeated questions reopen grief while each reply is joined to care for others and the final call to follow.
payload.title: Feed my sheep
